meta_skill_content:
Editing strategy for this environment:
1. Read success first: the fixed scoring skeleton is validated. Preserve the 8 items, 0/0.5/1 scale, table wording, and 0–4 / 4.5–6 / 6.5–8 footer cutoffs byte-for-byte. 001 and 003 produced identical scores across epochs; 002's 3.0→3.5 shift happened with an unchanged skill, so never recalibrate item weights or anchors from a single sample.
2. Highest-value next edit: put an unmissable output contract at the very beginning of the editable skill section. If SKILL_FIXED_START is editable, make its first line (before '本次分析岗位为') read: 最终回答必须且只能是一行 <score>X.X</score>；禁止空白、解释或其它字符；无法判断时输出 <score>0.0</score>. If fixed markers are immutable, start SLOW_UPDATE with the same sentence so it is read before the calibrations.
3. Compress SLOW_UPDATE to ~450 characters max; the previous compression recommendation was not implemented, so try it as a standalone edit. Keep: one launch/anti-blank rule; one 'no evidence=0, unclear=0.5, take lowest reasonable band' rule; then compact one-line calibrations per item — 1/4 cleaning/temp/cover=0.5, direct security/property=1; 2 '识少少/可以学'=0.5, '99%/能完成记录'=1; 3 structured=1, vague/needs prompting=0.5; 5 vague obey=0.5, concrete acceptance of dirty/heavy/shift work=1; 6 single vague reason≤0.5, income+children+career with positivity=1; 7 concrete caregiver arrangement=1, only '老婆照顾'=0.5, no arrangement/regular clinic=0; 8 long tenure+reasonable exit=1, short/gapped/unsupported=0.5, none=0. Delete repeated 'blank is forbidden' paragraphs; extra tokens do not change behavior.
4. Do not add new candidate-specific examples or new numbered items. Add a compact clause only if the same edge case recurs across at least two independent transcripts. Vague generic rules are useless; keep explicit score mappings.
5. Edit ranking: (a) top-placement output contract, (b) tail compression/merging, (c) only then any semantic calibration, and only if a real failure pattern appears. Make one small change per epoch.
6. Regression gate after every edit: run interviewer_001/002/003 at least 3–5 times. Acceptance: exact one-line <score>X.X</score>, never blank; 001≈5.5, 002 in 3.0–4.0, 003≈7.0. If blank/extra text appears or scores drift beyond tolerance, revert and retry a single smaller edit.
